svg.title: The Claude Code harness
svg.desc: Flow of one workflow task. A brief goes to an implementer, a Haiku agent confirms from git which commit was built, and an Opus critic, a Sonnet verifier and a Sonnet gate review it in parallel, then each finding goes to a fixer, to us for a style or scope decision, to a log of minor issues, to a set-aside pile for us to rule on, or the task completes.

text.tspan: one task, its files and checks
Haiku reads the commit from git

g.text: set aside for us to rule on
The fixer is the implementer’s seat;
the escalated fixer steps one tier up.
